title: Walk 17: put a project on a host and take it off again

steps.say: Start the two mock daemons and the interface with the host stand-ins as described in the guided walk. Use only invented answers in this walk.
Open checkout under the first mock machine, then its menu and Put this project on a server….

Click Choose the project tresor folder on this computer and pick /tmp/porelo-walk/tresor. The folder is then named at the top with Choose another, and the repository address and signing-key fields appear. Each path field has a Choose… beside it.

Give a Scaleway project id walk, a tresor walk, the server setup file /tmp/porelo-walk/porelo-host and the repository address https://example.org/walk.git; invented values are enough. Type the private key as ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 and the public and signing keys as ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub: a path from ~ is understood. Keep the account porelo.
Type ~nobody/key as the private key and click Put it on a server. A line refuses ~nobody and no step starts. Put ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 back.
Click Put it on a server. Its steps should reach a stop asking for the drive and a new vault.
Enter an invented plain Tresorit e-mail address. There must be no password, code or passphrase field in this dialog.

Click Open a terminal on the host. Read the warning about the visible one-time code. Type an invented password, then an invented one-time code, then a vault passphrase twice into the terminal prompts. Each command says what completed and what comes next.
When the terminal ends, click Done. Host setup runs up again without answers. The steps finish and the completed host can be added.
Hover the (i) beside Save the VPN connection to this server. It says what WireGuard is, that the file holds a private key and where to keep it, and the two commands that bring the VPN up.
Click Add this server to your machines, then Close. Open Machines and checkout server. It should answer through the second mock daemon, with only checkout and no work run yet.

Open checkout on the host, then its menu and Put this project on a server…. Fill the same invented project id, tresor and collection as before, with account porelo. Leave the local folder unchosen again.
Click Take it off the server. The give-back step finishes with Done. Close the dialog and check Machines: checkout server has been removed; the first mock machine remains.
Close the dialog and record anything that differed. To try a refusal or a slow step, change the situation in host-standin.json and reopen the dialog.
